scope: Local TaskEngine and CLI integration with a synthetic project-local coding skill, a duration parser, and simple/complex routing prompts.

findings.issue: The default Codex voting model gpt-5.1-codex-mini is rejected by this ChatGPT account.
findings.evidence: Both live routing prompts returned model_not_found.

findings.issue: Both routing prompts produced no valid votes.
findings.evidence: Claude and Gemini hit the 60000 ms seat limit; Codex rejected its configured model. Both tasks used fallback routing.

findings.issue: CLI completion is insufficient evidence of task completion.
findings.evidence: The existing Claude README smoke test finished idle with editedInPlace=false after tool permission refusals.

findings.issue: CLI health detection is sensitive to startup latency.
findings.evidence: Direct versions were available for all three providers, but 30000 ms probes intermittently marked Codex and Gemini unavailable.

findings.issue: The existing e2e fixture uses abbreviated Windows temporary paths.
findings.evidence: Claude rejected CJ8959~1.ADO paths as suspicious. The added harness normalizes temporary paths using fs.realpathSync.native.

findings.issue: Default test limits are too short for some local Git integration checks on this machine.
findings.evidence: Two tests exceeded 60000 ms; all five Git tests passed with a 120000 ms limit.
